title: ISP: give each client its own contract
purpose: Split student enrollment API by client responsibility.
alt: StudentEnrollment가 EnrolmentAPI와 AccountAPI를 구현하고 각 클라이언트가 필요한 인터페이스만 사용하는 구조
requiredChecks: EnrolmentAPI contains getSSN/getName; AccountAPI contains getInvoice/postPayment.
RoasterApplication uses EnrolmentAPI only; AccountApplication uses AccountAPI only.
StudentEnrollment implements both interfaces and retains four operations.
Course has zero-or-more StudentEnrollment records; client Course dependencies remain.
Client-facing segregation does not require two separate domain entities.
